scenarios.title: Locked-out employee account
scenarios.symptom: An employee cannot sign in after repeated incorrect passwords.
scenarios.setup: Use a synthetic test account under the documented lockout policy; verify the recovery admin first.
scenarios.diagnostics: Check exact error, account lockout/enable state, affected scope and recent attempts; verify the fictional requester.
scenarios.success: Approved unlock/reset permits a fresh sign-in; explain why unlocking without investigating can lead to recurrence.
scenarios.cleanup: Restore the test account to its intended state; do not expose or reuse its password.

scenarios.title: Wrong client DNS server
scenarios.symptom: Internet IP access works but domain names or shares fail.
scenarios.setup: Record WS01 DNS, then set an incorrect test DNS address on WS01 only.
scenarios.diagnostics: Compare address/gateway, IP reachability, external versus internal resolution and domain discovery.
scenarios.success: Client uses DC01 DNS again; domain and external names resolve and the original share opens.
scenarios.cleanup: Restore DHCP-derived settings or the recorded baseline; verify no public secondary DNS.

scenarios.title: Incorrect DHCP option
scenarios.symptom: A renewed lease supplies the wrong DNS option.
scenarios.setup: Record the lab DHCP option, change only the test scope DNS option, then renew WS01.
scenarios.diagnostics: Inspect lease server, address/mask/router/DNS; distinguish a valid lease with bad options from no lease.
scenarios.success: Correct scope option and renewed lease restore domain resolution.
scenarios.cleanup: Restore original scope settings and verify that home network configuration was untouched.

scenarios.title: Missing Finance access group
scenarios.symptom: A Finance employee receives access denied.
scenarios.setup: Remove an approved synthetic test user's Finance group membership after recording it.
scenarios.diagnostics: Compare effective groups, share and NTFS permissions; verify authorisation and fresh token behaviour.
scenarios.success: Approved access works after a fresh sign-in; a Sales control account remains denied.
scenarios.cleanup: Restore the approved membership and log the access change without broad ACL changes.

scenarios.title: GPO not applying to workstation
scenarios.symptom: Expected screen-lock or drive mapping settings are missing.
scenarios.setup: Move WS01 into a deliberately untargeted lab OU, recording its prior OU.
scenarios.diagnostics: Inspect OU/link/filter targeting and effective policy results; compare user versus computer settings.
scenarios.success: Return WS01 to intended scope and verify actual policy, not just a successful refresh command.
scenarios.cleanup: Restore OU membership and leave only the documented baseline GPOs active.

scenarios.title: Windows printing service issue
scenarios.symptom: A test print job cannot complete.
scenarios.setup: Use a synthetic PDF/available printer test; stop the print spooler only inside WS01 when appropriate.
scenarios.diagnostics: Inspect queue, selected printer, spooler state and document/application scope.
scenarios.success: Restart/recover the guest print subsystem and produce a verified test output.
scenarios.cleanup: Remove synthetic queued jobs; restore original guest service state; disclose whether no physical printer was used.

scenarios.title: Application install fails
scenarios.symptom: A requested application does not install.
scenarios.setup: Use a safe incorrect package path or invalid deployment parameter; do not download malware or corrupt production apps.
scenarios.diagnostics: Inspect return code/log and package path, installer type, permissions and supported version.
scenarios.success: A corrected approved package installs and launches under the standard test user.
scenarios.cleanup: Remove only test package artefacts; preserve useful sanitised logs.

scenarios.title: Application problem affects one user
scenarios.symptom: An application works in one test profile but not another.
scenarios.setup: Use a disposable browser/app profile and a reversible setting that causes the symptom.
scenarios.diagnostics: Compare profiles, settings and errors; establish whether OS-wide reinstall is justified.
scenarios.success: Correct the specific setting/profile state and verify both affected and control profiles.
scenarios.cleanup: Restore/delete only the disposable profile after exporting synthetic files; do not delete real Windows profiles.

scenarios.title: Low-space monitoring alert
scenarios.symptom: Health output reports low free disk space.
scenarios.setup: Raise Test-LabHealth's warning threshold above current free space; never fill the SSD.
scenarios.diagnostics: Check measured values, threshold, guest versus host storage and whether the warning represents a real capacity problem.
scenarios.success: Explain simulated alert, create a ticket, restore threshold and capture healthy result.
scenarios.cleanup: Restore production-like lab threshold and verify Lenovo free-space floor.

scenarios.title: Required test service stopped
scenarios.symptom: A health check reports a stopped service.
scenarios.setup: Choose a harmless lab-only service or disposable test component; record its original state.
scenarios.diagnostics: Inspect service status/startup and relevant events; distinguish missing service, permission error and stopped state.
scenarios.success: Restore the test service and obtain healthy output; no automatic remediation needed.
scenarios.cleanup: Return service and monitoring configuration to baseline; never stop AD/security/host services for this case.

scenarios.title: Patch or app-update failure
scenarios.symptom: An approved test update reports failure or remains pending.
scenarios.setup: Use a reversible guest connectivity interruption or safe invalid app-update job; label which kind was used.
scenarios.diagnostics: Inspect status/error, connectivity, pending restart, applicability and actual installed version.
scenarios.success: Correct the cause and verify update/version/restart result on the endpoint.
scenarios.cleanup: Restore connectivity and schedules; no indefinite pause of Windows updates or protection.

scenarios.title: Deleted file restoration
scenarios.symptom: An employee deleted a required sample document.
scenarios.setup: Back up a tiny synthetic file and record its hash/ACL before deleting the source copy.
scenarios.diagnostics: Locate correct backup/version and distinguish missing file from denied access.
scenarios.success: Restore to a separate path first, compare content/hash and verify intended access before replacing the source.
scenarios.cleanup: Retain test evidence and remove redundant copies; document whether an independent-device copy was tested.

scenarios.title: Single-user versus shared connectivity outage
scenarios.symptom: A user says the internet is down.
scenarios.setup: Disconnect only WS01's virtual cable for one run; use an explicitly simulated multi-user report for the queue comparison.
scenarios.diagnostics: Inspect link/address/route/DNS/application in order and separate observed scope from reported scope.
scenarios.success: Reconnect and verify original task; explain how multi-user impact would change priority/escalation.
scenarios.cleanup: Reconnect the guest adapter and verify DNS/domain access; do not change the home router.

scenarios.title: Managed endpoint offline
scenarios.symptom: The management console shows a stale/offline endpoint.
scenarios.setup: Record WS01 check-in then cleanly power it down.
scenarios.diagnostics: Check last-contact age, maintenance window and guest power before treating it as an outage.
scenarios.success: Power up and capture real renewed check-in; document observed reporting delay.
scenarios.cleanup: Restore running or intentionally scheduled-off state and close the alert appropriately.

scenarios.title: Mac connectivity diagnosis
scenarios.symptom: A Mac application cannot reach an online resource.
scenarios.setup: During a suitable break, briefly disable Wi-Fi or use a disposable app's offline setting; record the original state.
scenarios.diagnostics: Check connection, address, gateway, DNS and another app/site; avoid changing router settings.
scenarios.success: Restore the original setting and verify the original task plus a control resource.
scenarios.cleanup: Restore personal Mac connectivity immediately; no lab MDM/network profiles installed.

scenarios.title: Mac audio or application permission
scenarios.symptom: A meeting/test recording app has no microphone input.
scenarios.setup: Use a test app and reversible input selection or microphone permission change.
scenarios.diagnostics: Inspect selected input, input meter, application permission and another app as a control.
scenarios.success: Correct the selection/permission and verify a harmless test recording without publishing personal audio.
scenarios.cleanup: Restore preferred settings and delete unwanted private recordings.

scenarios.title: Suspicious access or phishing report
scenarios.symptom: A fictional user reports a suspicious link or MFA prompt.
scenarios.setup: Create a text-only synthetic example; use no live malicious URL or actual phishing delivery.
scenarios.diagnostics: Ask what happened, preserve useful reported details, identify scope and prepare escalation without requesting a password.
scenarios.success: Complete an accurate handover and safe user guidance; label the entire case tabletop.
scenarios.cleanup: No live security controls or accounts changed; remove any misleading mock content from normal inboxes.

scenarios.title: Mixed support queue and updates
scenarios.symptom: Several requests arrive with different impact and urgency.
scenarios.setup: Create three synthetic GLPI tickets with different scopes, workarounds and requested dates.
scenarios.diagnostics: Justify ordering, assign owners, record response times and separate internal notes from user updates.
scenarios.success: Resolve/reopen a test ticket, link an asset/KB and explain a prioritisation decision.
scenarios.cleanup: Close or clearly label remaining practice tickets; report timings as simulated practice metrics.

scenarios.title: New employee onboarding
scenarios.symptom: A new Finance employee needs access and a configured workstation.
scenarios.setup: Use an approved fictional request and an extra test identity; baseline staff remain unchanged.
scenarios.diagnostics: Check role approval, naming, groups, device needs, standard-user privileges and credential delivery procedure.
scenarios.success: User signs in and reaches intended resources; unrelated department access is denied; script batch variant verified separately.
scenarios.cleanup: Disable/remove only disposable users when finished after recording IDs; retain no passwords in ticket.

scenarios.title: Department transfer
scenarios.symptom: An employee moves from Sales to Operations.
scenarios.setup: Record the test user's approved old/new access.
scenarios.diagnostics: Check group memberships and resource access, including inherited membership and fresh logon token.
scenarios.success: New department access works and old access no longer works after refresh/sign-in.
scenarios.cleanup: Restore baseline department if the fixture is reused; record change history.

scenarios.title: Employee offboarding
scenarios.symptom: A fictional employee leaves the organisation.
scenarios.setup: Use a disposable account with synthetic data and a recorded approved request.
scenarios.diagnostics: Check disablement, active sessions, access removal and data-retention needs; distinguish new authentication from existing sessions.
scenarios.success: Fresh access is prevented and lab sessions handled; synthetic data preserved according to the request.
scenarios.cleanup: Keep account disabled or remove it only after review; do not delete baseline staff or real data.

scenarios.title: Workstation refresh
scenarios.symptom: The employee workstation needs a documented rebuild/reprovision.
scenarios.setup: Complete dependent local cases, back up test files, inventory apps and record recovery credentials before rebuilding the guest.
scenarios.diagnostics: Follow a deployment checklist and verify package/configuration choices; plan storage without a permanent duplicate VM.
scenarios.success: Rebuilt/reprovisioned client rejoins domain, restores test data, runs required apps and has updated asset record.
scenarios.cleanup: Reconcile old/new device records and remove obsolete agent registrations; disclose that image capture is not included.

scenarios.title: Remote support session
scenarios.symptom: A simulated remote employee needs help with an application setting.
scenarios.setup: Use the endpoint tool's supported session to WS01 and record simulated consent.
scenarios.diagnostics: Verify target identity, communicate intended action and observe the symptom before changing it.
scenarios.success: Resolve and verify the task; record session start/end and end access cleanly.
scenarios.cleanup: Close the session and restore any temporary setting; personal hosts were not targeted.

scenarios.title: Approved software deployment
scenarios.symptom: An employee requests a small approved free application.
scenarios.setup: Use a vendor-sourced package and target only WS01.
scenarios.diagnostics: Check approval, architecture, install parameters and detection method; capture pre-install inventory.
scenarios.success: Tool reports deployment and actual client version/launch verifies it; inventory difference captured.
scenarios.cleanup: Document uninstall/rollback and remove extra package copies if storage requires.

scenarios.title: Shared mailbox permission issue
scenarios.symptom: A test user can see a mailbox but cannot send as it, or cannot open it.
scenarios.setup: Use two licensed synthetic users and a test shared mailbox; change one intended permission.
scenarios.diagnostics: Inspect access versus Send As/delegation separately and allow recorded propagation time; check web client as control.
scenarios.success: Authorised user can perform requested action; unapproved user cannot.
scenarios.cleanup: Restore intended delegation and clean up synthetic messages/objects during trial teardown.

scenarios.title: OneDrive account or sync issue
scenarios.symptom: A sample file is missing locally or not synchronising.
scenarios.setup: Use synthetic files and pause sync or select a deliberately different test folder/account context.
scenarios.diagnostics: Compare web and desktop state, correct account, sync status and specific error before resetting anything.
scenarios.success: Correct state results in the intended file appearing/syncing and a verified edit.
scenarios.cleanup: Restore normal test sync; preserve needed evidence before removing test account.

scenarios.title: SharePoint access denied
scenarios.symptom: A test employee cannot open a document library.
scenarios.setup: Remove only a test group's expected access on the test site/library.
scenarios.diagnostics: Inspect account, group/site/library permissions and broken inheritance where relevant; check approved access.
scenarios.success: Expected user can access, a control user remains denied and no public sharing was needed.
scenarios.cleanup: Restore the intended access matrix and remove temporary sharing links.

scenarios.title: Cloud sign-in or MFA support
scenarios.symptom: A test user reports a sign-in/MFA problem.
scenarios.setup: Use a safe wrong-account or unregistered test MFA-method scenario with separate working admin access.
scenarios.diagnostics: Inspect exact error, account/licence/role, available sign-in evidence and allowed recovery path.
scenarios.success: Restore intended user sign-in with MFA where applicable and document verification without secrets.
scenarios.cleanup: Remove temporary test methods securely; never remove the only administrator's recovery access.

scenarios.title: Intune assignment or compliance issue
scenarios.symptom: CLD01 does not receive an expected setting/app or reports a compliance issue.
scenarios.setup: Use an intentionally incorrect test-group assignment or one supported reversible compliance setting.
scenarios.diagnostics: Check licence, Entra/MDM state, group assignment, last check-in, supported setting and device-side evidence.
scenarios.success: Correct targeted assignment/state, sync and verify device behaviour plus report update; record latency.
scenarios.cleanup: Restore intended policy and remove duplicate/stale records through documented teardown.

scenarios.title: Microsoft 365 user lifecycle
scenarios.symptom: A new employee needs cloud services, then a mover/leaver change.
scenarios.setup: Use two or three licensed synthetic users and a fictional approved request.
scenarios.diagnostics: Check available licences, groups, intended services, least privilege and data ownership.
scenarios.success: User accesses licensed services; later block/revoke/remove access appropriately and verify new access denied.
scenarios.cleanup: Preserve test evidence/data as planned, recover licences and document actual remaining objects.

scenarios.title: Enrol and configure CLD01
scenarios.symptom: A test endpoint must be managed through Intune.
scenarios.setup: Finish local phase, verify recovery admin, repurpose WS01 and follow cloud transition runbook.
scenarios.diagnostics: Check correct join flow, supported edition, licence/enrolment scope and device identity; distinguish registration from join.
scenarios.success: Entra join plus Intune record verified, one app and safe setting reach CLD01, and compliance status is explained.
scenarios.cleanup: Retire management before trial expiry; verify local access and stale-object cleanup.

scenarios.title: Teams membership and user support
scenarios.symptom: A user needs access to the test team's channel/files.
scenarios.setup: Verify a Teams-capable licence, create a tiny test team and use a second test account.
scenarios.diagnostics: Check account/tenant, membership and web versus desktop behaviour; no personal Teams substitution.
scenarios.success: Intended user can access the team/channel and a synthetic collaboration action works.
scenarios.cleanup: Remove test content/membership during teardown and record any licence limitation.
